page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i4.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with 4 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. The system configuration includes 32.0 GB of RAM, which yields a resource density of 8.0 GB of memory per virtual core.

A key hardware feature of this instance is its bundled local storage, consisting of a 959 GB SSD. This local storage is integrated directly into the hardware profile to support low-latency data access. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses or GPU hardware.

From a qualitative cost efficiency perspective, the ecs.i4.xlarge balances dedicated compute resources with a high memory-to-vCPU ratio and significant local SSD capacity. This resource density makes the instance appropriate for workloads requiring local data caching, relational or non-relational databases, and memory-intensive applications that benefit from dedicated CPU allocation and fast local storage.
